Looking for delicious ideas to make your Shravan vrat more exciting? We’re back with another collection of flavourful Vrat Special Recipes that are easy to make, satisfying and packed with deliciousness!
From crispy snacks to comforting dishes, this episode brings you 5 tasty Farali recipes that are perfect for your vrat menu:
Farali Batata Vada – crispy outside, soft and flavourful inside
Farali Sama Vada – golden, crispy and served with creamy dahi
Varicha Dosa – light, crispy and perfect with coconut chutney
Instant Sabudana Vada – an easy take on the classic vrat favourite
